column1: # collector-manifest.tsv — this directory is a PORT: a collector implementation
# in a language that is not Go. Carrying this file is what makes it one; the
# three collector censuses and the publish sweep all read it, and the keys below
# FORMAT: key<TAB>value, one pair per line. Tab rather than space so a build or
# test command carries spaces with no quoting rule for four readers in two
# NEITHER COMMAND PASSES --offline. The lockfile pins every dependency, so
# --locked is reproducible without forbidding the fetch that populates a cold
# machine — and the standalone census runs these commands in the STAGED
# PUBLISHED LAYOUT, which may be a cold checkout. The no-network assertion
# belongs in the CI leg, which pre-fetches with --locked and then runs the tests
